editorial:
Imagine waking up and feeling like you are just going through the motions of life without any real spark. You get exactly that vibe with this quirky French film. It mixes heavy drama with some really weird, funny moments that keep you guessing about what is actually happening in the lead character's head. The story focuses on a man who feels like a walking dead person, even though he is physically alive. It is a slow-burn experience that feels like a dream, making you question the difference between existing and actually living your life.

What really works here is the acting, which feels very raw and honest. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, the strange humor makes up for it. You will love this if you enjoy indie movies that take risks and do not follow a standard formula. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp visuals. If you prefer owning your films, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can rewatch the odd details later.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with the main character finally breaking out of his numb state. After a series of strange encounters, he realizes that his feeling of being dead was just a shield against the pain of reality. In the final scene, he makes a choice to embrace the chaos of life. He stops hiding and accepts his flaws, which allows him to feel genuine emotion again for the first time in years.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange indie stories and character studies.
